content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am looking to program the cursor keys (up/down) so they allow switching between three different text displays. Could someone advise how to achieve this? Thank you in advance to anyone who can assist.

Hello [user_name], If all three message texts are active permanently, controlling the switching via cursor keys isn't necessary—simply using up/down should scroll between them, with the message of highest priority showing first. If the texts aren't always active, you can assign each text to a separate cursor key. Add the icon for the chosen cursor key, connect this to a pulse relay, and then link that to the message text you want to display. Hope this helps.

Hello all, I have a strange issue when switching between text screens. After navigating through all available screens with cursor-down, pressing cursor-up causes the [product_name] to fully reboot, just like a power cycle (with the hourglass icon and program restart). I can reproduce this every time. Has anyone else experienced this?
This sounds like a hardware defect. I don't believe it is a programming issue.

I also suspect a hardware problem. Before requesting a replacement, I've attached a simple program used to trigger the issue. Just press the cursor-down key twice (the time/date screen appears), then press cursor-up. My device then restarts.
Hello, I tested your simple program but did not encounter any issues.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to use cursor keys on the [product_name] with display for switching between text screens. While some users find the navigation works as expected, others report a major issue in which pressing cursor-up triggers a complete reboot of the device. This inconsistent behavior raises doubts about whether the problem stems from hardware or configuration, and undermines user trust in the device's reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the cursor keys to consistently and safely allow navigation between text displays without causing unexpected errors or device restarts. The screen-switching process should be intuitive, dependable, and stable.
